text: Why did Straker go out to the stables at one in the morning? — a purpose of his own that he kept from his wife
id: q.straker_reason=a purpose of his own that he kept from his wife
why: Holmes calls the delicate cataract knife a strange thing to carry on a rough night outing. That gives a reader reason to doubt Straker's stated reason, merely checking on the horses, and to consider an undisclosed purpose.

text: Why did Straker have the small knife with him? — for some task he meant to do
id: q.knife=for some task he meant to do
why: Holmes stresses that the blade was made for very delicate work and is odd to carry, since it would not shut in a pocket. That directly invites the possibility that Straker brought it for some intended task.
